question: A lens and a prism both refract light. Explain why a lens can form an image while a prism mainly deviates and disperses light.

options.A: A lens forms images because it has two plane parallel faces, whereas a prism forms images because it has curved faces.
options.B: A lens has curved refracting surfaces that make rays converge or diverge from a point, so it can form images. A prism has inclined plane refracting faces that mainly deviate light and disperse colours.
options.C: A prism forms images more effectively than a lens because it has a larger angle of refraction.
options.D: Both a lens and a prism only deviate light; neither can form an image.
